capabilities: Generate one note per song from the local MusicLyricApp cache, including interleaved bilingual lyrics
Pull the full Discogs collection via the official API and enrich each release with tracklist, label and community data
Render notes from swappable .md templates with placeholders for each field
Deduplicate notes by netease_id or discogs_release_id, with an overwrite mode that preserves hand-filled fields
Optionally download cover images locally and show a live sync progress panel that can be stopped
extras: Documentation is in Chinese with an English summary for non-Chinese readers; the author states the plugin is 100% AI-generated, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. NetEase sync is desktop-only because it reads a cache directory outside the vault.
motivation: The author separates digital songs (managed via NetEase, read from MusicLyricApp's cache) from physical records (managed via Discogs), stating this two-path setup is enough for their needs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn streamed songs or a physical record collection into structured notes with metadata, lyrics and tracklists.

relations.evidence: NetEase Cloud Music — reads the local cache of MusicLyricApp (metadata + timestamped lyrics)
Discogs — uses the official API + a personal token to pull your entire collection

summary: Syncs NetEase Cloud Music songs and Discogs record collections into Obsidian as one note per song or record, with metadata, lyrics and tracklists.
